title: Normalized augmented presheaf bar-resolution data
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal E$ be a small category and $R$ a commutative ring. Write $\mathcal A_{\mathcal E,R}=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal E^{op},\operatorname{Mod}_R)$; it is the module-sheaf category [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] for the constant ring on the topology generated by singleton identities [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Derived categories and cochain complexes mean [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define normalized augmented presheaf bar-resolution data as the following functors, maps, coordinate isomorphisms, and laws (without asserting existence of such data). For $U\in\mathcal E$ and an $R$-module $M$, put $L_U(M)(V)=\bigoplus_{a:V\to U}M$, with restriction along $b:W\to V$ sending $(a,m)$ to $(ab,m)$. For $F\in\mathcal A_{\mathcal E,R}$, let $B_{\mathcal E,R}(F)^{-n}=\bigoplus_{U_n\to\cdots\to U_0}L_{U_n}(F(U_0))$ for $n\ge0$, with zero positive terms. On evaluation at $V$ its generators are $(V\xrightarrow a U_n\to\cdots\to U_0,x)$. The face $d_j$ deletes $U_{n-j}$, composing adjacent arrows (including $a$ when $j=0$); the last face restricts $x$ along $U_1\to U_0$. Use differential $\sum_{j=0}^n(-1)^jd_j$ for $n>0$, and augmentation $a_F(a:V\to U_0,x)=F(a)x$ in degree zero. A datum includes an additive functorial augmented complex realizing these formulas $a_F:B_{\mathcal E,R}(F)\to F[0]$, with the face identities $d_id_j=d_{j-1}d_i$ for $i<j$. At each fixed $V$, the augmented complex has the contraction $s_n(V\xrightarrow a U_n\to\cdots\to U_0,x)=(V\xrightarrow1 V\xrightarrow a U_n\to\cdots\to U_0,x)$ and $s_{-1}(x)=(1_V,x)$; it satisfies $ds_n+s_{n-1}d=1$, including $ds_0+s_{-1}a_F=1$ and $a_Fs_{-1}=1$. No naturality of $s_n$ in $V$ is asserted. The datum includes the law that $a_F$ is a quasi-isomorphism of presheaf complexes. Both $F\mapsto B_{\mathcal E,R}(F)$ and the complex $F\mapsto K_{\mathcal E,R}(F)$ defined by $K^{-n}=\bigoplus_{U_n\to\cdots\to U_0}F(U_0)$ with the same vertex-deletion faces (only the last face restricts the coefficient) preserve objectwise short exact sequences. With $C=\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal E^{op}}$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], the natural isomorphism $b_F:CB(F)\cong K(F)$ is identity on coefficients of generators; its degree-zero map identifies $C(a_F^0)$ with $(U,x)\mapsto\iota_Ux$ into $CF$. Composable-arrow deletion is the category-bar indexing construction of [def-trf-derived-colimit-bar-system]. The data include the coordinate isomorphisms and coproduct universal properties identifying the displayed generator sums with the complex terms, so no arbitrary complex or comparison is substituted.
